title: OceanCoder: A Verification-Guided Large Language Model for Automated Simulation Modelling in Ocean Engineering
title_zh: OceanCoder：面向海洋工程自动化仿真建模的验证引导大语言模型
abstract_en: Numerical simulation is important in ocean engineering, but model construction requires expert knowledge. Large language models support automated modelling, but code syntax and successful execution alone do not establish whether generated models and results meet engineering requirements. We present OceanCoder, a Qwen3-8B-based large language model for automated simulation modelling in ocean engineering. To address specialised programming requirements and scarce training data, we develop an extensible data construction pipeline producing 12,000 verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples across 12 engineering task categories. A three-layer verification framework checks model inputs against engineering parameters and task constraints, verifies completion of required simulation analyses, and assesses the engineering plausibility of computed outputs. Its outcomes provide graded rewards for group relative policy optimisation (GRPO), guiding the model towards engineering task completion. We also construct the first benchmark for automated modelling in ocean engineering, covering out-of-distribution tasks and real-world engineering cases. Experiments and ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the data pipeline, verification framework and reward design. OceanCoder outperforms both base models and the closed-source comparison, with Pass@1 increasing from 0% for the base model to 46.77% after SFT and 51.43% after GRPO. These results support engineering verification as a training signal for automated simulation modelling.
abstract_zh: 数值仿真是海洋工程的重要工具，但建模依赖专业知识。大语言模型可以辅助自动化建模，但代码语法正确、能够成功运行，并不意味着模型及其结果符合工程要求。本文提出基于 Qwen3-8B 的 OceanCoder，并构建可扩展的数据流程，为 12 类工程任务生成 12,000 条经过验证的监督微调（SFT）样本。三层验证框架依次检查模型输入是否符合工程参数与任务约束、是否完成所需的仿真分析，以及计算结果是否满足工程合理性要求。验证结果转化为分级奖励，用于组相对策略优化（GRPO），引导模型完成工程任务。作者还建立了首个面向海洋工程自动化建模的基准，涵盖分布外任务与真实工程案例。实验和消融研究验证了数据构建流程、验证框架和奖励设计的有效性。OceanCoder 优于基础模型和参与对比的闭源模型，Pass@1 从基础模型的 0% 提升至 SFT 后的 46.77%，再经 GRPO 提升至 51.43%。
key_points_zh: 构建覆盖 12 类工程任务的 12,000 条经验证 SFT 样本，缓解专业建模数据不足的问题。
三层验证分别检查输入是否合规、所需分析是否完成、输出是否符合工程常识，而非仅判断代码能否运行。
将验证结果转化为 GRPO 的分级奖励，使 Pass@1 在 SFT 的 46.77% 基础上进一步提高至 51.43%。
建立面向海洋工程自动化建模的评测基准，纳入分布外任务和真实工程案例。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 将任务约束、分析完成度和结果合理性的验证转为分级奖励以更新模型参数，并用消融及分阶段成绩评估收益；未显示验证机制自身演化。
